svg.title: AI-Assist — architecture and real status
svg.desc: AI-Assist architecture: Apple Watch and iPhone clients (validated in simulators) call a private AI gateway that owns device identity and pairing, rate limits, a budget ledger with kill switch, sanitized logs, server-side provider keys and PostgreSQL with row-level security; a model router with no silent fallback selects an adapter. Only the mock/simulated adapter is active; Anthropic and OpenAI adapters are ready but have never been called. Infrastructure-lab work lives in a separate copy. Prototype: not deployed, not on the App Store.
